adjudication.rationale: The server-side input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` only enforces `z.array(z.string().email())` and does not enforce uniqueness. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out emails that already exist on `booking.attendees` and blacklisted ones, but it does not de-duplicate duplicates within the `guests` payload itself. Therefore a direct tRPC caller can submit `["a@b.com", "a@b.com"]` (or case variants) and both entries will pass the filter and be inserted via `attendees.createMany` as duplicate attendee rows (unless there is an unseen DB unique constraint, which is not shown in the diff).
